answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract, then slash it if independent audits find that its supposedly distinct identities share control or coordinate to claim rewards. Audits can sample signed task histories and compare timing, reused outputs, and payment paths; no single clue proves fraud, but converging evidence triggers review. A Sybil attacker must fund every identity and risk losing the bonds, so cheap fake accounts become costly. Even a tundra timber seller may keep an ember-themed bot, but each still needs real collateral.
